title: pgAssistant - Collection Runs
description: Collection run health by target, with job-level failures, partial Executive Plans and diagnostic messages.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT '__ALL__' AS __value, 'All' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_group
list.label: Target group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(target_group,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(target_group,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name,target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: run_status
list.label: Run status
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS __value, status AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: job_type
list.label: Job
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT job_type AS __value, job_type AS __text FROM pga_collection_job_result ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status IN (${run_status:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT count(*) FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status='completed' AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT count(*) FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status='partial' AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT count(*) FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status='failed' AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT count(DISTINCT r.target_id) FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status IN ('failed','partial') AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status='completed')/nullif(count(*),0),1) AS success_rate FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring})));

SELECT date_trunc('${bucket:raw}',r.started_at) AS time,r.status AS metric,count(*) AS runs FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status IN (${run_status:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}))) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT r.target_id,count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status='failed') AS failed,count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status='partial') AS partial FROM pga_collection_run r WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}))) GROUP BY r.target_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('failed','partial'))>0 ORDER BY failed DESC,partial DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.title: Failed and partial runs - diagnostic
panels.description: Run-level and job-level errors. Advisor errors explain partial Executive Plan results.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.started_at,r.finished_at,r.target_id,coalesce(r.target_name,r.target_id) AS target_name,coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') AS environment,coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') AS target_group,r.status AS run_status,j.job_type,j.status AS job_status,j.response_time_ms,coalesce(j.error_message,r.error_message) AS collector_error,CASE WHEN p.advisor_errors IS NULL OR p.advisor_errors='[]'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_pretty(p.advisor_errors) END AS advisor_errors,r.run_id FROM pga_collection_run r LEFT JOIN pga_collection_job_result j ON j.run_id=r.run_id LEFT JOIN pga_executive_plan_snapshot p ON p.run_id=r.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status IN ('failed','partial') AND (j.job_type IS NULL OR j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}))) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC,r.target_id,j.job_type LIMIT 500;

SELECT r.started_at,r.finished_at,r.target_id,coalesce(r.target_name,r.target_id) AS target_name,coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') AS environment,coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') AS target_group,r.trigger_type,r.status AS run_status,j.job_type,j.status AS job_status,j.response_time_ms,CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(extract(epoch FROM (r.finished_at-r.started_at))*1000) END AS run_duration_ms,r.error_message,r.run_id FROM pga_collection_run r LEFT JOIN pga_collection_job_result j ON j.run_id=r.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND r.status IN (${run_status:sqlstring}) AND (j.job_type IS NULL OR j.job_type IN (${job_type:sqlstring})) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.target_group,'unknown') IN (${target_group:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x WHERE x.target_id=r.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}))) ORDER BY r.started_at DESC,r.target_id,j.job_type LIMIT 1000;
